OpenAI to retire older ChatGPT voice modes

OpenAI will discontinue its older ChatGPT voice modes, including the standard and advanced versions, on December 11. Users will be required to transition to the live voice mode. Additionally, OpenAI has introduced a "Business Hub" tool that allows companies to claim their business profiles within ChatGPT, verify their identity, and update details such as pricing and product availability.
